name: Prisoner's Diary
description: Pages torn from somewhere, filled with cramped, hurried writing.
paragraphs: They took my name on the first day. Told me I was 'Number Six' now, and that names were a luxury for people who hadn't broken the law.
I still remember it though. I say it to myself every night, quiet, so the guards don't hear. It's the only thing they haven't managed to take.
